name: Quadrature Rotary Encoder
description: Like an endless digital knob! Outputs quadrature pulses to measure clicks, speed, and direction of rotation.
realWorldAnalogy: Like an endless digital knob! Outputs quadrature pulses to measure clicks, speed, and direction of rotation.
wiringGuidance: Connect GND (Dark Slate) to GND, + (Red) to 5V, CLK (Green) to Pin 2, DT (Green) to Pin 3, and SW (Green) to Pin 4.
commonMistakes: Missing switch debounce filtering in software, causing erratic count jumps.
Swapping CLK and DT, which inverts rotation direction.

miniExperiment.title: Endless Dial Counter
miniExperiment.circuit: GND to GND, + to 5V, CLK to Pin 2, DT to Pin 3.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Rotating the knob clockwise increases position in Serial Monitor; counter-clockwise decreases it.
